```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotrix)
library(nycflights13)
library(readr)

titanic <- read_csv("~/Desktop/titanic3 (1).csv")
titanic <- titanic |>
  mutate(age_cat = ifelse(age > 17, "Adult", "Child"))

titanic_df <- titanic |>
  as.data.frame()

flights <- flights |>
  mutate(on_time = ifelse(arr_delay > 0, 0, 1))

flights_df <- as.data.frame(flights[!is.na(flights$on_time), ])

  
  
top_carriers <- flights |>
  count(carrier, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  pull(carrier)

flights_df_top5 <- flights |>
  filter(carrier %in% top_carriers, !is.na(on_time)) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

## What is Plotrix

* plotrix allows its user to make specialized plots and complex visualizations
* Much of what plotrix can do is possible with ggplot, but plotrix makes things significantly easier

## Warning!
Have to use a data frame, not a tibble.
```{.r code-line-numbers="|2"}
titanic_df <- titanic |>
  as.data.frame()
```

## Building a Nested Hierarchical Bar Plot

```{.r code-line-numbers="1|2-3|4|5-6|7"}
barNest(
  survived ~ pclass + sex,
  data = titanic_df,
  FUN = c("propbrk", "binciWu", "binciWl", "valid.n"),   
  main = "Titanic Survival by Class and Sex",
  ylab = "Proportion Survived",
  shrink = 0.15
)
```

## Adding Color

```{.r code-line-numbers="8-12"}
barNest(
  survived ~ pclass + sex,
  data = titanic_df,
  FUN = c("propbrk", "binciWu", "binciWl", "valid.n"),   
  main = "Titanic Survival by Class and Sex",
  ylab = "Proportion Survived",
  shrink = 0.15,
  col = list(
    "lightgray",
    c("navy","red4","darkgreen"),
    c("pink","lightblue")
  )
)
```

## Another One (Variable)
```{.r code-line-numbers="2|11"}
barNest(
  survived ~ pclass + age_cat + sex,
  data = titanic_df,
  FUN = c("propbrk", "binciWu", "binciWl", "valid.n"),   
  main = "Titanic Survival by Class and Sex",
  ylab = "Proportion Survived",
  shrink = 0.1,
  col = list(
  "lightgray",
  c("navy","red4","darkgreen"),
  c("gold","coral"),
  c("pink", "lightblue")
  )
)
```

## Clock Plots {auto-animate="true}

```r
flights_hourly <- flights |>
  count(hour) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

## Clock Plots {auto-animate="true}

```r
clock24.plot(
  lengths = flights_hourly$n,
  clock.pos = flights_hourly$hour,
  rp.type = "r",
  main = "NYC Flights Departure Times (By Hour)",
  line.col = "darkblue",
  lwd = "7",
  show.grid.labels = 3
)
```

## Clock Plots
```{r}
flights_hourly <- flights |>
  count(hour) |>
  as.data.frame()

clock24.plot(
  lengths = flights_hourly$n,
  clock.pos = flights_hourly$hour,
  rp.type = "r",
  main = "NYC Flights Departure Times (By Hour)",
  line.col = "darkblue",
  lwd = "7",
  show.grid.labels = 3
)
```
## 3D Pie Charts (Exploding)

```{r}
titanic_class <- titanic |>
  count(pclass
        )
```

```{.r code-line-numbers="5-7"}
pie3D(
  titanic_class$n, 
  labels = c("1st Class", "2nd Class", "3rd Class"),
  main = "Pie Chart of Titanic Passenger Class Distribution",
  explode = 0,
  theta = 0.9,
  start = pi/2,
  col = c("salmon","navy","lightblue")
  )
```

pie3D(
  titanic_class$n, 
  labels = c("1st Class", "2nd Class", "3rd Class"),
